function f(a: number) { arguments[0] = 9; return a; }
function g(a: number) { a = 7; return arguments[0]; }
function h(a: number, b = 2) { arguments[0] = 9; return a + b; }
function k(a: number) { delete arguments[0]; arguments[0] = 5; return a; }
function len(...xs: any[]) { return arguments.length; }
console.log(f(1), g(1), h(1), k(1), len(1, 2, 3));
function ins(a: any) { return arguments; }
const args = (ins as any)(1, 2);
console.log(Array.isArray(args), args.length, Object.keys(args), JSON.stringify(args), [...args]);
